title: DURING the flood: Stay safe
learningObjectives: PLACEHOLDER: Move to higher ground during a flood.
PLACEHOLDER: Recognize flood hazards: moving water, hidden holes, fallen wires.

intro.situation: Night. The street outside McDonkey is flooding and the water keeps rising.
intro.goal: Lead your sibling to the safe second floor of McDonkey. Avoid hazards in the water.

hazards.name: Open manhole
hazards.feedback: Flood water can hide open manholes and holes. Avoid walking where you can't see the ground.
hazards.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

hazards.name: Live wire
hazards.feedback: Stay far from fallen power lines. Water carries electricity.
hazards.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

hazards.name: Fast water
hazards.feedback: Even shallow moving water can knock you down. Don't cross it.
hazards.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

questions.objective: PLACEHOLDER: Act fast and go to higher ground.
questions.speaker: player
questions.situation: The water is rising fast. What do you do first?

choices.text: Go to higher ground now, with my sibling.
choices.feedback: Correct! Move to higher ground right away.

choices.text: Go back for my toys first.
choices.feedback: Things can be replaced. Get to safety first.

choices.text: Swim around to see how deep it is.
choices.feedback: Never play or swim in flood water.

questions.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

questions.objective: PLACEHOLDER: Stay away from electrical hazards.
questions.speaker: player
questions.situation: A power line is down and sparking in the water ahead.

choices.feedback: Don't go near it. Water can carry electricity to you.

choices.text: Keep far away, and tell an adult or the authorities.
choices.feedback: Correct! Keep your distance and report it.

questions.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

questions.objective: PLACEHOLDER: Use stairs, not elevators, during a flood.
questions.speaker: player
questions.situation: To reach the second floor: take the elevator or the stairs?

choices.feedback: The power can fail in a flood and trap you. Use the stairs.
Correct! Stairs are safer when power may fail.

questions.source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. Client to supply the reference.

takeaways: PLACEHOLDER: Go to higher ground right away.
PLACEHOLDER: Avoid flood water, moving water and fallen wires.
PLACEHOLDER: Use stairs, and stay with your family.
